thesis: Automation can expand practical capacity while concentrating power over options and disguising accountability.

ideas.statement: Meaningful control requires reasons, uncertainty, refusal and remedy, not a final click; trace duties to objectives, data and oversight and protect privacy against invasive accountability.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Scenarios are hypothetical, verbal fluency does not prove machine moral status, and transparency of authority differs from surveillance of vulnerable people.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Scenarios are hypothetical, verbal fluency does not prove machine moral status, and transparency of authority differs from surveillance of vulnerable people.

audit.notes: All source units read directly; thought experiments and unresolved theological issues kept conditional.
